title: How to Automatically Generate a Fashion Tech Pack from a 3D Garment
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/4c680edb7dd0417fb49086d0e812a74a/images/12f72309090941829e695adc4cf16f17auto-generate-tech-pack-thumbnail-wide.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/4c680edb7dd0417fb49086d0e812a74a/images/3ad5116ab40f490b92896a2f3e5159d0web%20tech%20pack.png)Most product teams create a tech pack after the design is finished. But what if your tech pack could grow naturally alongside your 3D garment instead?

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1WSQCRnMOzU?start=0

A tech pack can be generated automatically from a 3D garment: when patterns, materials, measurements, and colorways are defined during design, that data becomes the tech pack, with no separate documentation step required. Here's how that workflow works with CLO and CLO-SET.

## Creating a tech pack shouldn't be a separate process

A tech pack is one of the most important documents in fashion product development. It communicates everything manufacturers need to produce a garment consistently, from materials and measurements to construction details, grading, and colorways.

Yet for many fashion brands, creating a tech pack is still treated as a separate task that begins only after the design is complete. Once a style is approved, product teams manually gather information from multiple sources. Bills of Materials are recreated in spreadsheets, Points of Measure are documented separately, product images are exported again, and every design revision requires another round of manual updates.

**The problem isn't creating a tech pack. It's recreating product information that already exists.**

## What Is a Tech Pack?

A tech pack is a production document that communicates every detail needed to manufacture a garment accurately. A typical tech pack includes:

  * Bill of Materials (BOM)

  * Points of Measure (POM)

  * Size grading

  * Colorways

  * Product specifications

  * Construction details

  * Graphics

  * Production notes




Traditionally, all of this information is collected after the garment has already been designed. This workflow has become an industry standard, but it means teams spend their time recreating data instead of building products.

## The information you need is already inside your 3D garment

Modern product development starts long before a tech pack is created. As designers develop garments in CLO, they're already defining the information required for production: they create patterns, assign materials, select trims, define measurements, complete grading, and prepare colorways.

In other words, the product information needed for manufacturing gets built throughout the design process. Instead of collecting the same information again later, a connected workflow lets that product data continue into production.

## From 3D Garment to Tech Pack

Connect CLO with CLO-SET and the product information created during garment development flows directly into a connected digital workflow. Rather than creating a tech pack from scratch, teams keep working with information that already exists.

  1. **Design the garment in CLO**




Create the garment while defining patterns, materials, trims, and construction details.

  2. **Build BOM and POM**




Instead of documenting production information after the design is complete, build it directly into your 3D garment as you work. In CLO, you can define the Bill of Materials and place Points of Measure directly on your 2D patterns. Once grading is applied, measurements are automatically organized across all sizes, and product information stays connected to each colorway. You're building accurate product information as part of the design process, so it's ready for production from the beginning.

  3. **Upload to CLO-SET**




Once the garment is uploaded, BOM, POM, grading, and colorway data are automatically synchronized to CLO-SET. The latest product information stays connected and ready for tech pack generation, without anyone copying specifications into spreadsheets.

  4. **Export a production-ready tech pack**




When the product is finalized, generate a production-ready tech pack directly from the latest synchronized product information. Available export sections include:

  * Product Overview

  * Bill of Materials (BOM)

  * Points of Measure (POM)

  * Graphics

  * Cutter's Must

  * Comments

  * Annotations




Nobody has to recreate product information by hand before handing products over to manufacturers.

## Build BOM and POM once, not twice

One of the biggest sources of wasted time in product development is duplicate work. Teams create BOMs in one system, manage measurements somewhere else, and then recreate everything inside a tech pack. Every design revision repeats that work.

With CLO and CLO-SET, BOM and POM become part of the product itself. Production data stays connected to the 3D garment, so updates remain synchronized throughout development and teams maintain consistent product information with less manual work.

## Why digital tech packs improve product development

A connected digital workflow helps fashion teams move beyond manually maintaining documents.

Instead of recreating information throughout development, teams can:

  * Reduce repetitive manual work

  * Keep BOM and POM synchronized with product updates

  * Reduce errors caused by duplicate documentation

  * Generate production-ready tech packs faster

  * Keep production information accurate and up to date

  * Create a more efficient product development workflow




The tech pack stops being another document to maintain and becomes the natural outcome of product development.

## From product development to production, without rebuilding your tech pack

A tech pack shouldn't be something you create after product development. It should evolve with the product. Connect CLO and CLO-SET, and fashion teams create product information once, then generate production-ready tech packs from the latest synchronized data. The time that used to go into rebuilding information for production goes back into the products themselves.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is this an AI tech pack generator?**  
Not in the generative-AI sense, and that's intentional. Generative AI can draft documents, but production documents live or die on accuracy. CLO-SET generates tech packs from the structured data already inside your 3D garment: patterns, materials, measurements, grading, and colorways defined during design. The output is based on your actual product data, not a model's prediction.

**What data syncs from CLO to CLO-SET?**  
BOM, POM, grading, and colorway data sync automatically when you upload your garment. Export sections include Product Overview, BOM, POM, Graphics, Cutter's Must, Comments, and Annotations.

**Do I need a tech pack template if I work in 3D?**  
If your product data lives in your 3D garment, the tech pack is generated from it, so there's nothing to fill in from scratch. If you're still working in 2D, start with the fundamentals: [[How to Make a Tech Pack](https://style.clo-set.com/en/resources/article/ea95bf7b27ca48619b9b76752097aa70)]

See it with your own garment. Upload a 3D garment to CLO-SET and export a production-ready tech pack from your existing product data.

[Get Started Free](https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus)
content_description: Streamline fashion product development by automatically generating accurate, production-ready tech packs directly from your 3D garment data using the integrated CLO and CLO-SET workflow.

title: "Custom measurement" is a useless feature
content:
The whole point of custom measurements for graphics is to create a point of reference so the graphic can be placed accurately in a real life application, but there's NO WAY to translate this information to any exportable data. It isnt in POMS it isnt in anything outside of the file so the only thing you can do is take a screenshot and give it to the print house.  
  
What. This seems like an incredibly important part of the production process that is completely missing from clo. Simple features like this and not able to export shrinkage data to DXF printing make clo completely unusable for production.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, you can place an additional POM for the graphic placement with a few clicks, which would be less of a hassle than taking and sharing a screenshot. You can also shrink pattern pieces by editing them by percentage and export that as a DXF.
content_description: Highlighting the critical limitations of CLO software in exporting custom measurement data and shrinkage information essential for accurate graphic placement and production.

title: 2026 Q2 Updates in CLO-SET: Better Product Reviews, Smarter Tech Packs
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/89535736d72d44f0aa994cfb7358f6e5/images/90f78820eb614616a5e621b2fdb6d83fwhatsnew-3-q2.png)Q2 updates cover the full stretch between product reviews and production documentation: better vendor communication, more confident quality reviews, and more complete tech packs.

Explore what's new in [CLO-SET](https://style.clo-set.com/).

# [Product Review & Collaboration]

# Product reviews involve vendor communication, repeated revisions, and continuous quality checks. This quarter adds capabilities that reduce the back-and-forth in both areas.

**Simplify product requests with Virtual Showroom**

Virtual Showroom now offers a faster way to communicate with vendors and business partners during product development. With Add to Selection & Send Email Requests, users can select multiple styles and send product requests directly from Virtual Showroom, so product communication stays in a single workspace.

![9dc5c46adfb844b8b3fdce34733839c5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/89535736d72d44f0aa994cfb7358f6e5/images/9dc5c46adfb844b8b3fdce34733839c5image.png)

**Speed up quality reviews with AI QC Bot (Beta)**

Reviewing quality results across many products takes time. AI QC Bot (Beta) analyzes detected QC data and summarizes potential issues in 3D garments, so teams understand quality results quickly before the next stage of development. Instead of checking every QC item one by one, reviewers can focus on validating and resolving the highlighted issues.

![3e7e4b1ee3934648a6207c41ffdabde6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/89535736d72d44f0aa994cfb7358f6e5/images/3e7e4b1ee3934648a6207c41ffdabde6image.png)

# [Product Presentation]

**Create better presentations with the updated Visual Board**

Visual Board has a redesigned interface and better workspace organization. The new layout makes mood boards, presentation slides, and product assets easier to arrange, which makes the workspace more intuitive for product presentations.

![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58772957407385)

# [Smarter Tech Packs]

**Export more complete digital tech packs**

The closer a product gets to production, the more its documentation needs to carry. Tech Pack exports now support additional sections beyond Overview, BOM, and POM: teams can include Cutter's Must, Graphics, and Annotation & Comments when exporting to Excel or PDF, so more technical information fits in a single export. Complete digital tech packs can now be generated directly from CLO-SET for production and collaboration.

![681e897d8ee849c68eab3e517323e784](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/89535736d72d44f0aa994cfb7358f6e5/images/681e897d8ee849c68eab3e517323e784image.png)![e835feee42e0446794861e179e62083c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/89535736d72d44f0aa994cfb7358f6e5/images/e835feee42e0446794861e179e62083cimage.png)
content_description: Discover the latest CLO-SET Q2 enhancements designed to streamline vendor communication, accelerate quality reviews with AI, improve product presentations, and deliver more comprehensive digital tech packs for efficient product development.
